title: inspect_system specification
description: Optional knobs for niagara.inspect_system. Response always includes result.topology_summary (emitters→modules→renderers) at top; response_detail=summary omits full graphs[], complete (default) includes graphs[]. Target path is on the envelope. Owned by WS-07.

emitters.description: If set, restrict inspection to these emitter names. Omit for all emitters.

stacks.description: Module stacks to include. ParticleEventScript requires extensions.niagara.event_handlers (lossy until Epic topology exposes usage GUIDs — RB-07).

include_input_values.description: When true, resolved module input values are returned (GetEmitterInputValues / GetModuleInputValues).

include_dependencies.description: GetSystemDependencies: modules, DIs, dynamic inputs, renderers.

include_compile_state.description: Await in-flight compile via GetSystemCompileState before returning.

response_detail.description: summary = topology_summary + counts (no graphs[]). complete = topology_summary + full graphs[]. Overrides envelope options.response_detail.
